Tata Communications Expands Infrastructure, Appoints New CTO

Tata Communications has announced two key developments: the expansion of its subsea cable infrastructure connecting India and Singapore, and the appointment of Rupesh Chokshi as its new Chief Technology Officer. These moves signal the company's focus on enhancing digital connectivity and strengthening its technological leadership.
